name: ui-stage
summary: An operated scene rebuilt in code instead of recorded: a terminal, browser or app window whose lines are printed, pasted or typed by hand (pinyin through an input method's composition and candidate box), a keyboard whose keys go down as they are typed, a cursor with its presses and rings, a step chip, and a player for real captures of an interface (one picture a small step, cross-faded) with a camera in their own pixels, a spotlight and a ring of light.
use: P = { window, lines, keyboard, cursor, steps, capture, marks, camera, … }; st = state(P, t); canvas(ctx, st, P, pics) draws it (pics: { name: drawable } or name => drawable, the capture pictures already loaded: needs(st) names the ones this frame draws; loader(src, keep) loads them when asked and keeps a few, for a page whose frame(t) returns a Promise); or els = build(root, P) once and dom(els, st) each frame (the DOM painter tilts the capture with the camera's rx, ry; it loads one a state, so keep it to a few dozen states). events(P): [{ t, kind }] for the sound pass (key, space, enter, paste, line, click, drag, step). planLine(line) gives a line's letter times and its end, so the next line, a cut or a word of the narration can follow it; project(st, x, y, space) is where a point of the stage or of the capture lands on the screen. Every value is a function of t and P: state() keeps nothing between frames. A wrong line is an error that names it.

slots.name: window
slots.text: { kind: terminal | browser | app, x, y, w, h, title, url }: the frame in stage px (a 60 px bar with three dots and the title, or a browser's address pill; app has no bar); null: no window

slots.name: lines
slots.text: the window's lines, top to bottom: { at (s), text, how: print (even, cps 60, each letter rising into place) | paste (all at once, highlighted 0.6 s, fading over 0.7 s) | type (by hand: cps 14, uneven, punctuation 1.9× longer) | ime (parts: [[hanzi, pinyin], …], cps letters a second, default 16: the letters compose underlined with a candidate box, a space commits them), prompt (shown at at, not typed), color, enter (an Enter 0.25 s after a typed line ends) }. One line each: cut long output in the middle with …

slots.name: size
slots.text: the lines' text size; 44 px is the desktop floor for text that is read (playbook/03 §4), and the stage's camera can push it further

slots.name: keyboard
slots.text: { x, y, w }: a keyboard (four rows and a space bar, about w × 0.34 tall) whose keys go down 0.05 s before each typed letter, the space for a committed pinyin part, Enter for enter, and come back over 0.32 s, lit in the accent; null: none

slots.name: cursor
slots.text: { keys: [[t, x, y]], clicks: [t], drags: [[t0, t1]], space: stage | capture | screen, size (px, 74) }: an arrow on lib/motion.js's cursorPath (eased, on a slight arc) pressed by presses() (16 % smaller when down), a ring for each click (0.45 s, 14 → 84 px); keys in the space's px, drawn through its camera

slots.name: steps
slots.text: [[t, number, text], …]: the step chip; the number and the text rise 60 px into place over 0.4 s, the first chip slides in from the left over 0.5 s; text at 44 px

slots.name: chip
slots.text: [x, y]: the chip's top-left corner on the screen (84 px tall); keep it in the action-safe box and clear of the captions

slots.name: capture
slots.text: { states: [[t, name], …], fade (s, 0.09: each state cross-fades from the one before), size: [w, h] (the pictures' CSS px, e.g. a 1440 × 900 viewport captured at device scale 3), at: [x, y] (where the camera's point lands, default the frame's centre), camera: [[t, cx, cy, zoom, rx, ry], …] (the picture's point (cx, cy) lands at at, zoom screen px per picture px, eased inOutCubic between keys; empty: the whole picture fits, 1800 × 960 at most; rx, ry tilt in degrees, DOM painter only), view: [x, y, w, h] (the screen box the pictures show in, null: anywhere), src (the DOM painter's picture path, {name} in it) }

slots.name: marks
slots.text: [{ t0, t1, box: [x, y, w, h], kind: spot | ring, space }]: spot dims everything else to 62 %, ring draws a 6 px ring of light round the box; each eases in and out over 0.25 s; box in the space's px (capture when there is one, else stage)

slots.name: camera
slots.text: [[t, cx, cy, zoom], …]: the stage's camera: the stage point (cx, cy) lands at the frame's centre, zoom × (the window and the keyboard move with it); empty: still

slots.name: colors
slots.text: the terminal's body and bar, an edge, the text and the dim text, the prompt, the accent (keys, rings, the chip's dot), the paste highlight and the composition's underline, an error colour for lines that use it, a browser's light bar and dark ink, and the spotlight's dark as r,g,b

slots.name: font
slots.text: the CSS family list for the chip, the candidate box, the keys and the bar (lib/text.js fontStack(tokens, role) makes one from a style)

slots.name: mono
slots.text: the lines' family list; keep a CJK family in it, or Chinese falls back (bin/vh fonts check)

slots.name: seed
slots.text: the seed of the uneven typing (lib/core.js hash): another seed, another hand

sample.text: the contact sheet's moments: claude typed by hand; the pinyin composing with its candidate box and the keys lit; Enter; the capture player pushing in on the column, a row clicked, the note typed a picture a letter, added, the spotlight and the ring; the printed lines

provenance.path: a 2026-11 tutorial film made with it (video-types/12-product-tutorial.md)
provenance.note: its pinyin typing, keyboard and real-interface player (states, camera, hand, spotlight, ring), made one component with a canvas and a DOM painter
